changes: Removed the per-layer full cube recomputation used only for unconsumed fact-width metadata.
Removed the per-ReLU before-fact conversion used only for two unconsumed diagnostic differences.
Replaced two identity-diagonal sparse products with one direct CSR subtraction on the dominant unscaled relation path.
Computed opposite exact relation rows once, reused the identical outward error allowance, and applied one exact CSR negation.
Canonicalized CSR once at affine and mixed-row replacement producer boundaries.
Skipped two redundant boolean CSR row copies when a relation retains its complete row block.
Used a direct all-active outward-inflation path instead of three boolean gather/scatter copies.
Avoided a boolean sparse-matrix SpMV when every source-mass column is positive.
Reduced absolute CSR data directly in canonical row order instead of cloning data, indices and indptr for row-L1 mass.
Validated fixed scalar roundoff operation counts before broadcasting, eliminating repeated row-sized finite/range reductions.
Reused canonical affine-operator indices and indptr for abs(W), allocating only absolute data when a negative stored bit exists.
